'''Swang's Swoopers''' was a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] operating out of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The group was led by [[Swang]], and included a [[Swooper/Legends|swooper]] called [[Mossol]] the Menace.<ref name="Sand" />
